title: The Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every finite dimension
summary: We prove the Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every finite dimension: every locally compact second-countable Hausdorff group acting faithfully and jointly continuously on a connected Hausdorff second-countable finite-dimensional topological manifold without boundary is a Lie group.
family_title: The Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every dimension

review.reason: Proves that faithful continuous actions on manifolds force the acting group to be a Lie group.
